The Pervasive Interaction (PI) Lab at Department of Computer Science and Technology of Tsinghua University is seeking a postdoctoral researcher to join the lab for 2–3 years. This position is eligible for the Shuimu Tsinghua Scholar Program, which offers competitive salary, housing support, and strong career development opportunities. If you are interested, please email: yuntaowang@tsinghua.edu.cn.

*1. Research Areas* We are particularly interested in candidates working in:
• Physiological and behavioral sensing
• Health sensing / mobile health
• Human–AI collaboration in health applications

*2. Position Overview* The postdoctoral researcher will conduct cutting-edge research on sensing and interactive systems for health, with emphasis on physiological sensing, health sensing, and human–AI collaboration in health. In addition to research, the postdoc will co-supervise PhD and master’s students, contribute to the preparation and execution of national and industry-funded projects, and engage in broader academic collaborations. Teaching opportunities may also be available as needed.

*3. Eligibility* Applicants should meet the following requirements for the Shuimu Tsinghua Scholar Program:
1. Hold a PhD degree obtained within the past three years, or expect to
receive it before the start date.
2. Be able to work full-time at Tsinghua University.
3. Pass the department’s interview and recommendation process.

*4. What We Offer* The Shuimu Tsinghua Scholar Program provides:
• Salary: RMB 200,000 - 400,000 per year (before tax), with additional
project-based finalcial support
• Housing: On-campus transitional housing or a housing subsidy of up to RMB
42,000 per year
• Medical Benefits: Same medical benefits as Tsinghua faculty
• Child Education: Access to Tsinghua University’s kindergarten and primary
school
• Career Development: Faculty training opportunities and support for
attending leading international conferences

*5. Application Materials*
1. Detailed CV, including publications and research/education experience
2. Cover letter (research statement) describing research interests and fit
for the position
3. Academic materials demonstrating research achievements, such as papers,
patents, or awards

*6. How to Apply*

*Please send your application materials to:Yuntao Wang, Email:
yuntaowang@tsinghua.edu.cn <yuntaowang@tsinghua.edu.cn>*

In your cover letter, please indicate your interest in the Shuimu Tsinghua Scholar Program. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis.

For more information about the Shuimu Tsinghua Scholar Program, please visit:

*Yuntao Wang* Research Associate Professor Department of Computer Science and Technology, Tsinghua University Ziqiang Tech. Building Room 1-904, Tsinghua University, Beijing, 100084, P.R. CHINA E-mail: yuntaowang@tsinghua.edu.cn
